title: A bill to designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 1335 Jefferson Road in Rochester, New York, as the "Specialist Theodore Matthew Glende Post Office".
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was introduced. The summary of that version is repeated here.)

Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 1335 Jefferson Road in Rochester, New York, as the "Specialist Theodore Matthew Glende Post Office."

summary.headline: Names a Rochester, New York post office building after Specialist Theodore Matthew Glende.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames a United States Postal Service facility at 1335 Jefferson Road in Rochester, New York, as the "Specialist Theodore Matthew Glende Post Office." It is a naming measure only. It does not change how the post office operates, its services, or its staff.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on November 26, 2014.
